findings.description: The GitHub coverage workflow generated the metric coverage matrix before generating scale_build_metrics.json, so a fresh CI run could omit L07 cluster_build coverage from coverage_matrix.json.

acceptance_criteria: scale_build_metrics audit status PASS with blocking_findings_count 0 on committed evidence.
Canonical real rungs 30, 50, and 100 are present and trace to wrapper-produced evidence.
Resource preflight failure or can_run=false for canonical rungs is blocking.
Real evidence requires real_valkey=true, Valkey 9.1.x, exact node count, cluster_state_observed=ok, probe_result=PASS, and data_path_result=PASS.
50/100 timing metrics are measured from P13 timing/setup/runtime artifacts.
30-node timing gaps remain explicit MISSING with reasons.
Cleanup residue is blocking and cleanup timing gaps are explicit.
Rendered HTML/SVG/CSV/Markdown are rejected as measured metric sources.
P14 remains dry-run-only with real_valkey_coverage=false and no real evidence counted.
risks: Local pytest is unavailable in this environment, so focused tests were executed directly by importing test functions instead of through pytest.
The scale_build_metrics.json report artifact is generated by the audit gate and intentionally not left as a persistent workspace change in this response.
